description: Full-duplex, vision-enabled voice assistant for Windows — 100% local, on-device. Barge-in interrupts, desktop screenshots give the LLM visual context, and STT (whisper.cpp) + LLM (llama.cpp) run on Vulkan with no PyTorch/CUDA. Streaming Piper TTS in pt-BR. GGML edge AI.
